programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert & the Rattlesnakes
programs.desc: Robert wrangles western diamondback rattlesnakes in Arizona for the first time, learning techniques passed down by his dad  Terri helps save some of the hospital's tiniest patients, three baby feathertail gliders  Bindi chats with Occa the cockatoo.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Wedged In a Hedge
programs.desc: Not-so-friendly Ruby is trapped in a dense evergreen hedge  Shaun must hurry to stop a scared cat named Fuzz from jumping out of a tree.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Elephant Country
programs.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers that has been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programs.title: Alien Sharks Greatest Hits
programs.desc: A showcase of unusual sharks with the most unbelievable adaptations and unique mutations, from the dark, frigid waters of the Arctic to the boiling, volcanic cauldrons of the Pacific  a search for the cookiecutter shark and the lantern shark.

programs.title: The Zoo: A Sea Lion Pup Grows Up
programs.desc: Zoo staff face unexpected setbacks weaning a bright sea lion pup off its mother's milk  the bird team steps in to support a rejected curassow chick  a squirrel monkey visits the dentist.

programs.title: My Cat From Hell: Fluffy's Last Stand
programs.desc: A mother and daughter are being torn apart by their cat Missy, who seems determined to kill their other cat Fluffy  a tortie named Candy beats up a 9-year-old because she isn't so sweet.
